svg.title: DXDL Track 2 planner board
svg.desc: Eight-week design track with five stages: Align, Design, Critique, Refine and ready, Converge and close; three squads A, B and C, shared work, and four open decisions.
svg.text: Design sprint planner board / draft baseline
Calendar starts B/C alignment before the
preceding critique; confirm the start rule.
Choose flows, file location and sharing owner.
Fit relative weeks to squad and DXDL lead
W8 names Phase 4 but defines only 0–3;
confirm readiness check and engineering role.
* B/C alignment weeks follow the PDF calendar; its prose offset rule differs. Source: KLM DXDL Track 2.pdf, pp. 1–3. Design only.
